body:
Tiger’s Eye has long been known as the stone of courage, confidence, and keen awareness. With its golden bands of light, it activates both the root and solar plexus chakras—helping you stand in your power while seeing clearly where the flow of abundance is leading you.

The Diamond cut amplifies this even further, representing precision and value. Just as a diamond point directs energy, this shape turns Tiger’s Eye into a potent talisman of direction and discernment. It’s the “energetic currency” that ensures your wealth and energy flow into the right places—not scattered or wasted.

Energetically, Tiger’s Eye balances logic with intuition, allowing you to trust your instincts while staying grounded in practical decisions. Whether you’re stepping into leadership, navigating new opportunities, or setting financial intentions, this stone provides the steady courage to back your choices with conviction.

At Energy Muse, we view this Tiger’s Eye Diamond as both a protector and a magnet—deflecting distractions while drawing in prosperity. When paired with Honey Calcite Coins, you create a duo of confidence and flow: the drive to act and the energy to attract.
